description: Get YouTube video transcript/captions (manual or auto-generated) with timestamps. Use 'lang' to pick a language code (e.g. 'en', 'id'), or omit it to get the first manual track (else the first auto-generated one); get_transcript_languages lists the codes. Returns both timestamped and plain text versions, paginated with startSegment/nextStartSegment. available=false with reason NO_CAPTIONS or LANGUAGE_UNAVAILABLE when captions are absent; access problems (ACCESS_BLOCKED etc.) are errors.

lang.description: Language code for the transcript (e.g., 'en', 'id', 'ja'). Omit to get the first manual track, or the first auto-generated one if there is no manual track. get_transcript_languages lists the codes.

maxSegments.description: Maximum number of transcript segments to return. 0 (default) returns as many as the server allows per response (currently 500). Use with startSegment for pagination.

startSegment.description: Segment index to start from (0-based). Use nextStartSegment from the previous response to paginate through long transcripts.

video.description: YouTube video URL or video ID

name: get_video_transcript

availableLanguages.description: Language codes that do exist, when reason is LANGUAGE_UNAVAILABLE

isAutoGenerated.description: Whether the returned track is YouTube's automatic (ASR) captions; null if unknown

languageCode.description: Language of the returned track; the requested code when unavailable; null when none was requested and the video has no captions
